## translateEmailMessage

Translate Email Message. `POST /email-messages/{email_message_id}/translate`

Translate an email message body and cache the result in email metadata.

Cached translations are stored in email_metadata.translations so repeated requests for the same language return instantly.

```php
$result = $sendseven->chatTranslation()->translateEmailMessage(emailMessageId: 'email_message_id', targetLanguage: 'target_language');
```

- Scopes: `messages:read`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$emailMessageId` | `string` | yes |  |
| `$targetLanguage` | `string` | yes | ISO 639-1 language code (e.g. 'en', 'de') |
| `$idempotencyKey` | `?string` | no | Repeat a request safely: SendSeven answers a repeat with the first result. One is generated when omitted. |

Returns `TranslateMessage`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/Chat%20Translation/translate_email_message_api_v1_email_messages__email_message_id__translate_post)

## translateMessage

Translate Message. `POST /messages/{message_id}/translate`

## translateText

Translate Text. `POST /translate`

Translate arbitrary text for outbound message composition.

When target_language is "auto", the language is detected from context_messages (recent inbound messages from the contact).

```php
$result = $sendseven->chatTranslation()->translateText(text: 'text', targetLanguage: 'target_language');
```

- Scopes: `messages:create`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$text` | `string` | yes | Text to translate |
| `$targetLanguage` | `string` | yes | ISO 639-1 code or 'auto' |
| `$conversationId` | `?string` | no | Conversation ID to fetch recent inbound messages for auto-detect |
| `$idempotencyKey` | `?string` | no | Repeat a request safely: SendSeven answers a repeat with the first result. One is generated when omitted. |

Returns `TranslateText`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/Chat%20Translation/translate_text_api_v1_translate_post)
